description: Additional business valuation and financial data required for UK high net worth business owners beyond standard questionnaire fields

required.label: Total Assets
required.description: Sum of all current and non-current assets on the balance sheet, required for asset-based and net asset value calculations.

required.label: Total Liabilities
required.description: Sum of all current and long-term liabilities including debt obligations, required for net asset value and working capital calculations.

required.label: Industry Earnings Multiplier
required.description: Industry-specific multiple (typically 2-7x) applied to earnings or EBITDA for valuation, varies by sector competitiveness.

required.label: Revenue Multiplier
required.description: Industry-specific multiple applied to annual revenue for valuing high-growth or pre-profit businesses.

required.label: P/E Ratio
required.description: Price-to-earnings ratio based on comparable companies (typically 2-25x) used for profit-based business valuation.

required.label: Annual Cash Flow
required.description: Projected annual cash flow from operations used in capitalization of earnings valuation method.

required.label: Capitalization Rate
required.description: Industry-specific rate (e.g. 10%) used to convert annual cash flows or excess earnings to present value.

required.label: Market Value of Assets
required.description: Current fair market value of tangible business assets, added to goodwill value in excess earnings method.

required.label: Excess Earnings
required.description: Earnings above normal return on assets attributable to goodwill, used in excess earnings valuation.

required.label: Discount Rate
required.description: Rate used to discount future cash flows to present value in DCF and present value calculations.

required.label: Projected Free Cash Flows
required.description: Array of projected free cash flows for each future year used in discounted cash flow valuation.

required.label: Residual Terminal Value
required.description: Terminal value of business at end of projection period, added to DCF valuation.

required.label: Current Assets
required.description: Total assets convertible to cash within one year, used for working capital calculation.

required.label: Current Liabilities
required.description: Total short-term obligations due within one year, used for working capital calculation.

required.label: Net Annual Profits
required.description: Bottom-line net profit after all expenses, used for P/E ratio and SDE calculations.

required.label: Pre-Tax Income (EBT)
required.description: Earnings before tax used as base for Seller's Discretionary Earnings adjustment.

required.label: Depreciation & Amortization
required.description: Annual non-cash expenses added back to calculate true earning potential in SDE.

required.label: Owner Discretionary Expenses
required.description: Owner-specific non-essential expenses added back to reflect earnings available to new owner.

required.label: Non-Recurring Items
required.description: One-time gains/losses adjusted out of earnings for normalized SDE calculation.

required.label: Annual Income
required.description: Consistent annual business income stream used for present value calculation.

optional.label: RNRB Applicable
optional.description: Indicates if Residence Nil Rate Band (£175,000) applies to property inheritance for enhanced IHT exemption.

optional.label: Total Capital Gains
optional.description: Gross capital gains realized in tax year before applying annual CGT allowance.

optional.label: Annual CGT Exemption Used
optional.description: Portion of annual CGT allowance already utilized, affects remaining taxable gains calculation.

optional.label: Regular Gifts from Surplus Income
optional.description: Annual gifts from surplus income exempt from IHT, in addition to £3,000 annual exemption.
